After the fall of the Later Liang to Li Cunxu, the personal guard of Zhu Wen was stripped of their weapons. This spear fell into the armory of Li Congrong. 
But during the chaos at Tianjin Bridge, Li Congrong was killed by An Congyi. The spear once again vanished into exile. 
Shi Shouxin recovered it on the battlefield. He had hoped to wield it in glorious campaigns. But peace had already settled across the realm. The cry of the wild geese, once sharp enough to pierce the skies, was now nothing but a fading echo. 
Before it could carve a new tale with its new master,
the spear was sealed away, a silent witness to the warrior's unspoken bitterness and regret.
